text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky and I are on our way home
when we
pass a certain street.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, is this place...

text_block_list.text: Can't you see, Trainer?! This spot...

text_block_list.text: Can't you see, Trainer?! This spot...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: This is where Eight Blossoms of Youth was filmed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky catches me off guard with
the name
of a classic TV show.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:

street corner
where Momotaro and
Yoshimi reunite in the first
episode!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I never thought I'd stumble on the
location of
such a cool, trendy TV show!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
We have to recreate the scene, Trainer!
Come on!

text_block_list.text: You play Momotaro, and I'll be Yoshimi!

text_block_list.text: You play Momotaro, and I'll be Yoshimi!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: A few days after a totally bogus chance encounter, Yoshimi walks down the street and bumps into a certain someone...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The two of them look at each other and
shout,
"Ahh! You again!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Sigh... So cool and hip! Let's go, Trainer!

text_block_list.text:
She has sparkles in her eyes. I guess I
have no
choice...

location from the drama to recreate its
famous scenes until
Maruzensky is
satisfied.
